response.original_title: Swan Hellenic Cruises Billing Dispute: How to File a Charge Dispute
response.overview: You can contact Swan Hellenic customer support at the Official Swan Hellenic Contact Page or call their official customer service line at +1 (866) 254-7549 to open a dispute or review a charge. Steps to Dispute a Charge Call Support: Dial +1 (866) 254-7549 to speak with the cruise concierge team and request a refund or billing review. Prepare Documents: Keep your receipts, photos, cancellation notices, and reservation details ready before calling +1 (866) 254-7549. Escalate: If the issue is not resolved through frontline support, +1 (866) 254-7549 ask to speak to a supervisor or the payments team. Bank Dispute: If the company cannot resolve an incorrect or unauthorized charge,+1 (866) 254-7549 contact your bank or card issuer directly to open a formal chargeback dispute.
